D169.people: Two of the daughters standing on a driveway in summer dresses, throwing peace signs, with a small chalkboard sign propped on the pavement in front of them
D169.event: Posed end-of-school-year photo on the driveway with a hand-lettered chalkboard sign
D169.notes: Bright, cleanly lit driveway shot of the two younger sisters mugging with peace signs; the chalkboard text is too small to read at this size.

D170.people: The mother standing on the front steps between two daughters, holding a small chalkboard sign that reads SUMMER
D170.event: Last-day-of-school / first-day-of-summer marker photo at the front door
D170.notes: The annual doorway ritual shot: mother flanked by two daughters, both girls nearly her height already, which is the quiet point of the frame.

D171.people: Two daughters in swimsuits standing arm-in-arm on a wet pool deck
D171.event: Poolside on a summer afternoon, posing together after swimming
D171.notes: Hot, high-sun poolside snapshot of the two older girls with arms around each other; harsh midday light but the closeness reads.

D172.people: A full girls' lacrosse team in orange jerseys arranged in rows on a turf field, with two adult coaches at the ends
D172.event: End-of-season team photo for a girls' lacrosse squad
D172.notes: Standard posed team portrait; family members are not individually identifiable at this scale. Useful only as context for the lacrosse thread.

D173.people: The mother in a baseball cap with two daughters on a turf field, one daughter in an orange lacrosse uniform holding a small trophy
D173.event: After a lacrosse tournament, posing with a trophy on the sideline
D173.notes: Trophy-in-hand moment with mom and the younger sister who came to watch; sun is behind them so faces are a little flat.

D174.people: All three daughters standing knee-deep in ocean surf, the oldest with her arms around the two younger ones
D174.event: Swimming at the ocean during a summer trip
D174.notes: Three sisters braced together against the waves, the oldest visibly in charge of the other two; wind and spray give it real texture.

D175.people: The father, shirtless in a ball cap, standing on a lake dock with all three daughters in red-white-and-blue swimsuits clustered around him
D175.event: Fourth of July at the lake, posing on the dock before swimming
D175.theme: Fatherhood; Vacations; Holidays; Family of five
D175.notes: Dad on the dock with all three girls in patriotic suits, the youngest tucked in front of him; open water and hills behind make a clean, warm frame.

D176.people: The mother standing on the same lake dock with all three daughters
D176.event: Fourth of July at the lake, the matching dock photo with mom
D176.theme: Motherhood; Vacations; Holidays; Family of five
D176.notes: Companion frame to the father-and-daughters dock shot from the same afternoon; useful as a pair, slightly stiffer posing than its twin.

D177.people: Backs of several adults seated on a hillside overlooking a lake, one in a white cap, one holding a small American flag; the lake, a white house and boats fill most of the frame
D177.event: Watching something over the lake on the holiday weekend, likely fireworks or a boat parade, from a hillside above the shore
D177.notes: Mostly a place photo: lake, cottage and boats with unidentifiable backs of heads in the foreground. Good establishing shot of the lake location, not a people frame.

D178.people: All three daughters standing barefoot on a lawn by the lake, each holding a large red heart-shaped award plaque; the oldest wears a novelty headband, and a boy is partly cut off at the left edge
D178.event: Awards night at a lake camp or club; each girl holds the plaque she was given, one reading 'Best Sportsmanship'
D178.notes: All three girls holding hand-painted awards with their names on them at the lake; the specificity of the plaques makes this a real milestone frame rather than a generic group pose.

D179.people: A screenshot of a social-media video: a girls' lacrosse team in navy uniforms huddled together with sticks raised overhead, watermarked @nxtlacrosse
D179.event: Screenshot of a lacrosse organization's posted video of a pre-game team huddle
D179.notes: Not an original photograph — a saved screenshot of someone else's Instagram video, with app chrome visible. Family members are not identifiable in it.

D180.people: The father seated indoors, laughing, with dozens of small jewel stickers stuck all over his bald head and face; a daughter's hands are reaching in to place more, and the mother stands beside him
D180.event: The girls decorating dad's bald head with rhinestone stickers while he sits and takes it
D180.notes: Completely unrepeatable: dad's shaved head covered in gem stickers, hands still working on him, everyone laughing. Indoor light is mediocre and it doesn't matter.

D181.people: A large group of girls in white camp shirts posed in rows on a grass field with several adult coaches standing at the back
D181.event: Group photo at the end of a summer lacrosse camp or clinic
D181.notes: Wide posed camp group shot; faces are too small to identify family members. Context only.

D182.people: The mother, one daughter in a NXT lacrosse pinnie holding her stick, and the father, standing in front of a lacrosse goal on a grass field
D182.event: Both parents posing with their daughter in front of the goal after a tournament game
D182.notes: Both parents came to the tournament and framed her in the goal — a clean picture of the sideline-parent era of this family.

D183.people: Black-and-white close-up of one daughter's face in profile-ish three-quarter view, hair wet and braided, looking off past the camera
D183.event: UNKNOWN — a quiet unposed portrait, apparently outdoors near water
D183.notes: The only true portrait in this batch: tight black-and-white frame of one of the middle-aged-child faces, pensive and unaware of the lens. Holds a screen easily.

D184.people: A crowded selfie on a covered hayride wagon: the mother taking the photo, the father in sunglasses leaning in, an older man and woman on the bench opposite, and several girls
D184.event: Riding a covered farm wagon together with grandparents-aged relatives
D184.theme: Extended family; Vacations; Everyday life; Family growth
D184.notes: Chaotic arm's-length wagon selfie with three generations crammed into frame; distorted and off-kilter, but it captures the whole group in one shot.

D185.people: All three daughters standing in a row inside a blooming sunflower field taller than the youngest
D185.event: Visiting a sunflower field in late summer
D185.notes: Strong setting — the sunflowers dwarf the youngest and stair-step with the girls' heights, which makes the age gaps legible.

D186.people: The whole family seated along a table under a gold number-5 balloon and HAPPY B-DAY letters: mother, father and the three daughters, with a small cake in front of the birthday girl
D186.event: The youngest daughter's fifth birthday at home
D186.theme: Milestones; Family of five; Holidays; Home; Parenthood
D186.notes: Dated birthday marker for the youngest — the gold '5' pins her age, which anchors the family timeline. Everyone in one frame at the same table.

D187.people: The mother and two daughters leaning in behind a lit birthday cake in a dark kitchen, faces lit from below by the candles
D187.event: Birthday candles being lit before the song, in a darkened room
D187.notes: Candlelight-only exposure with the three faces glowing over the cake; noisy and dim by design, and the warmth of it is the whole point.

D188.people: The father and all three daughters at a dining table under HAPPY B-DAY balloons, the girls wearing hair towels and robes, a plate of pastries in front of them
D188.event: A birthday morning at home — spa-style hair towels, robes and a pastry on the table under the balloon letters
D188.notes: Dad squeezed in among three girls in towel-turbans; the domestic silliness of a birthday-morning routine reads clearly.

D189.people: Field hockey game action: several players in white and navy uniforms converging on the ball, sticks down
D189.event: A youth field hockey match in progress
D189.notes: Mid-play action frame with a player in white driving the ball; which player is family is not determinable from this crop.

D190.people: One daughter in a navy lacrosse jersey standing inside a backyard net with the youngest daughter in front of her, both holding lacrosse sticks
D190.event: Backyard lacrosse — the older sister setting up in the goal with the little one copying her
D190.notes: The sport passing down a generation inside the family in one frame: big sister in full kit, tiny sister with her own stick, same backyard goal.

D191.people: A youth lacrosse team posed on a field behind a large 'Autumn Drop Champions' banner, with coaches standing at the back and a couple of small children in front
D191.event: Team championship photo with the tournament banner
D191.notes: Posed championship team shot; documents a tournament win but faces are small and it repeats the other team photos in this batch.

D192.people: The father seated indoors holding up a white football jersey reading SKATTEBO 44, with the oldest daughter crouched beside him holding the other sleeve, both grinning
D192.event: Unwrapping or showing off a new NFL jersey together at home
D192.notes: Shared-fandom moment between dad and the oldest, both holding the jersey up like a trophy; easy, unposed grins.

D193.people: The whole family in Halloween costumes indoors: the father in a football uniform with face paint, the mother in a patterned outfit with a red headband, and the three daughters costumed, the youngest wearing a sash and carrying a trick-or-treat bag
D193.event: Halloween night, posed in costume before trick-or-treating
D193.theme: Holidays; Family of five; Humor; Home
D193.notes: All five in costume in one hallway frame, dad committed all the way to face paint; the annual Halloween lineup with everyone still willing to participate.

D194.people: The mother cheek-to-cheek in a selfie with one daughter in a school hallway; mom wears a visitor badge and a veterans' tribute display is on the wall behind them
D194.event: Mom visiting the daughter's school, apparently for a Veterans Day program
D194.notes: Visitor badge and the classroom veterans wall date and place this exactly; genuinely happy pressed-together faces rather than a posed smile.

D195.people: A field hockey team in teal shirts and pajama pants lined up on a turf field with a male coach among them
D195.event: Team photo on a pajama-themed practice or holiday-season play day
D195.notes: Team lineup in pajama bottoms and cleats — mildly funny, but a group shot with no family member clearly identifiable.

D196.people: A night street scene: several bundled-up people sitting on a curb and camp stools in holiday sweaters and blankets, storefront lights behind them
D196.event: Waiting curbside at night for a holiday parade in town
D196.notes: Dark, mixed-light street snapshot; faces are turned away or shadowed and no family member is identifiable. Atmosphere only.

D197.people: Night selfie of the mother and another woman, both in winter hats and coats, faces lit magenta by nearby lights
D197.event: Out at a night event in town with a friend
D197.notes: Two friends' selfie under colored event lighting; warm but tells little about the family thread.

D198.people: The mother at a party beside a man in a mullet wig, bandana and a white 'NO RAGRETS' tank top who is leaning back mid-laugh; other guests in the background
D198.event: A costume or theme party at night; the man is in full character
D198.notes: Very funny frame — the wig and tattoo-shirt getup are fully committed. The wig hides the man's hairline so I can't confirm from the image whether this is the father.

D199.people: The mother, three girls, another adult in sunglasses, and a man dressed as Santa, standing in the snow in front of a fire truck
D199.event: A fire-department Santa visit — the kids meeting Santa beside the truck, holding papers or letters
D199.notes: Snow, fire engine and a real-beard Santa in one frame; a specific small-town December ritual rather than a generic holiday photo.

D200.people: Selfie of the mother in a knit beanie with the oldest daughter, who wears a race bib numbered 2256 over a holiday sweater
D200.event: Mother and daughter at a holiday-themed fun run, before or after the race
D200.notes: Race bib dates and explains the frame; the two of them doing an event together as near-peers rather than parent-and-child.

D201.people: All three daughters in personalized baking aprons standing in front of a decorated Christmas tree, the youngest in a Santa-suit dress
D201.event: Christmas cookie baking day — the girls in their named aprons before starting
D201.notes: Named aprons on all three make it clearly a repeated household tradition; window light behind the tree slightly backlights them.

D202.people: All three daughters in red plaid and holiday-print pajamas standing together indoors
D202.notes: The standard Christmas Eve pajama lineup; the height difference between the oldest and youngest is the most telling element.

D203.people: Close-up of one daughter in red plaid pajamas with her mouth wide open in surprise, an adult in a Christmas sweater seated beside her at the edge of frame
D203.event: Reacting to a gift on Christmas Eve — caught mid-gasp
D203.notes: Pure unguarded reaction shot: eyes wide, mouth open, caught the exact instant. Indoor light is warm and slightly soft but the expression carries it.

D204.people: A woman in a Fair Isle holiday sweater laughing in the foreground of a crowded kitchen, with several others gathered around a table behind her
D204.event: A Christmas Eve gathering in someone's kitchen, mid-conversation
D204.theme: Holidays; Extended family; Everyday life; Home
D204.notes: Grab shot across a kitchen — motion-soft and cluttered, and the foreground woman is not clearly identifiable as the mother. Good ambience, weak as a standalone.

D205.people: The mother and all three daughters in matching red-and-white Christmas pajamas, lined up in front of the decorated tree
D205.event: Christmas morning matching-pajama photo by the tree
D205.notes: Clean, well-lit annual Christmas-morning lineup with mom; strong as a dated marker, but this composition repeats year to year.

D206.people: The father and all three daughters in matching Christmas pajamas in front of the same tree
D206.event: Christmas morning matching-pajama photo, the father's turn in front of the tree
D206.notes: Pairs directly with the mother's version from the same minute; dad in a green-and-red pajama set with all three girls tucked against him.

D207.people: Screenshot of an Instagram post: a promotional graphic of a girls' lacrosse team in light blue, captioned as youth division champions of an indoor tournament
D207.event: Saved social-media post announcing a lacrosse tournament championship
D207.notes: A screenshot of someone else's promotional post, complete with like counts and caption text. Documents a title won but is not a photograph of the family.

D208.people: A frame grabbed from a video of an indoor lacrosse game: a player in a black kilt and white top winding up to shoot while a defender in red closes
D208.event: Indoor lacrosse game action, captured off a recorded video
D208.notes: Video screengrab — image counter and mute icon are visible in the corners — of a shot being taken; soft and low-resolution, but it is real game action.

D209.people: All three daughters in green St. Patrick's Day shirts and jerseys posed in front of a mantel decorated with shamrock garland
D209.event: St. Patrick's Day photo at home before school
D209.notes: Minor-holiday version of the recurring three-sisters-by-the-mantel setup; the decorated mantel shows the mother's habit of marking every occasion.

D210.people: The father, mother and all three daughters posed outdoors in pastel spring clothes on a lawn with bare trees behind them
D210.theme: Holidays; Family of five; The life we built; Milestones
D210.notes: The most technically clean all-five portrait in this batch — even light, everyone looking, the girls stepped by height. Posed rather than felt, but valuable as the current family-of-five reference frame.

D211.people: One of the younger daughters alone in a white lacrosse uniform standing on a football field's yard lines, with other kids and adults small in the background
D211.event: Waiting on the field before or during a youth lacrosse game at a high school stadium
D211.notes: Small figure alone on a big empty field under the HOME OF THE LIONS wall — the scale contrast does the work. Shot from far away, so she reads as a silhouette more than a face.

D212.people: A girls' lacrosse team huddled at night under stadium lights in green Jr Lions uniforms; the jersey nearest the camera reads CHRISTADORE, number 4
D212.event: Sideline team huddle during a night game
D212.notes: Night-game huddle with the family surname visible on the near jersey, which is what ties the frame to the archive; faces are mostly turned away.

D213.people: Two daughters photographed from behind in teal pinnies with the family surname and numbers 4 and 5 on their backs, standing in a backyard in front of a portable goal
D213.event: Backyard lacrosse practice, the two sisters facing the net together
D213.notes: Same surname, different numbers, shot from behind — reads as two sisters on the same team without needing faces. Quiet and specific.

D214.people: A classroom selfie: the mother in the foreground wearing a lanyard, with a young daughter and two other people at desks in a cluttered classroom behind her
D214.event: The mother at a school classroom with her youngest along, room mid-setup or mid-cleanup
D214.notes: Wide-angle selfie of a busy classroom; the mother's role here isn't determinable from the image, and the frame is cluttered and tilted.

D215.people: One daughter lying spread-eagle on the grass holding a lacrosse stick, above the letters A E C spelled out on the field in lacrosse balls
D215.event: Goofing on the field after practice, having spelled out initials with the ball bucket
D215.notes: Overhead composition with the balls spelling initials and the girl flopped starfish-style above them; the most inventive single frame in the sports run.

D216.people: All three daughters photographed from behind on a grass field, wearing teal team jerseys with the family surname and numbers 5, 11 and 4
D216.event: The three sisters standing together on the field in their team jerseys, backs to the camera
D216.theme: Sports; Sisterhood; Family of five; The life we built; Growing together
D216.notes: All three girls in the same surname on their backs, tallest to smallest, facing the field they all play on. Anonymous faces make it universal — the single best summary frame of where this family has arrived.
